subject: Printing and supplies
body:
2026-10-10T14:55:00+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Paula, don't start the demo programme run yet. Nora is still missing descriptions, and blank boxes are not an approved design.
2026-10-10T14:55:58+02:00 — Paula Dietrich: Fine. Separately, the folded welcome pack sample works with Lukas's short-edge setting. The last page is finally upright.
2026-10-10T14:57:05+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Can we approve that preset for the pack without making it the default for every job?
2026-10-10T14:58:23+02:00 — Paula Dietrich: Yes, I'll give it a proper name after the sample check. TEST is still on it so nobody mistakes the trial for a finished batch.
2026-10-10T14:59:46+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Uma's sheet count is the one for the paper order, then. We don't need the larger single-sided quantity.
2026-10-10T15:00:50+02:00 — Paula Dietrich: I'll put the sample beside the order form. If someone changes the layout again, we'll test one copy before buying a small forest.
